visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a stabilized POV shot from a moving motorcycle. A fluffy brown and white Corgi dog is lying calmly on a tan-colored padded cushion or bag placed on the fuel tank area. The rider's hands are visible on the handlebars, maneuvering the vehicle through a residential street with older brick and concrete buildings under an overcast, bright daylight sky. (2) The editing shifts into a fast-paced montage, showing the motorcycle navigating various narrow Taiwanese streets and intersections. White painted lines and the Chinese character for 'Stop' are visible on the asphalt. The bike passes parked white cars, scooters, and small shops, including one with a red-and-white sign. The Corgi remains relaxed, looking forward as the scenery changes rapidly between residential alleys and wider roads. (3) The motorcycle continues into a very narrow alleyway with blue-shuttered buildings and weathered walls, then transitions back to a slightly wider street with utility poles and dense power lines. The rider wears tan pants and a watch on the left wrist. The sequence concludes as the bike exits a narrow path, with a single pedestrian visible in the distance on a crosswalk, maintaining the consistent travel narrative.
